name: tool with dreams
description: Labels, merges, reflections, subject aliases, verdicts on possible updates and citations of curated memories for the memory of the compacted conversation. Every field is optional; cite only ids and names printed in the input. With dreams on, also at most 3 hypotheses, guesses kept apart from memory.

supportingIds.description: Ids of shown records of the user's own words that bear the memory out.

content.description: One guess the records suggest but do not state, worded as a question or a condition; it is kept apart from memory and never read as a fact.

supportingIds.description: Ids of the shown records it is drawn from.

id.description: The later record of a listed possible update.

updates.description: The earlier record it may update.

verdict.description: confirm: the later value replaces the earlier one, and the later record supersedes it; reject: both values hold.

content.description: One line carrying every specific of the merged records.

ids.description: The ids of the two or more records the merged line replaces: never attempt, file, commit, note, decision or convention records, nor records with different scopes.

kind.description: What the record is. Ignored for attempt, file, commit, note, decision and convention records, whose kind code set, and for user corrections and preferences.

scope.description: The qualifier that tells two figures apart; records with different scopes never replace each other.

subject.description: Short lowercase noun phrase; a path a/b/c nests it under a broader subject. Reuse listed subjects.

supersedes.description: Ids of records this one replaces, only on an explicit correction; it must carry their specifics.
